title: Apple releases security updates for icloud for Windows
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-380.12.03.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – Apple Releases Security Updates for iCloud for Windows
leadParagraph: Apple has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in iCloud for Windows. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Apple has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in iCloud for Windows. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

It is encouraged that users and administrators review the Apple security page for and apply the necessary updates.

Please visit the link provided below:
iCloud for Windows 11.5
